d: Long, flowing platinum-white hair is styled with a side-swept fringe and a high ponytail, featuring a soft, silky texture. The almond-shaped eyes are a pale mint green with a calm, neutral expression on a youthful, mature face. The build is slender, dressed in a high-collared white cloak with gold trim over a dark grey and white striped undergarment. Long pointed ears and red drop earrings are the only distinguishing accessories, while a golden staff topped with a large red orb is held to the side.
